prompts_and_generated_patches.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: original-resolution cropped repair patch for a real estate photograph.
Input image: the sole supplied image is the edit target, a 1536 x 1024 pixel crop of the original photograph.
Primary request: Completely remove the upper-right DFH overlay: all large red and white letters, the thin red horizontal rule, and the entire 'Disability Forever Homes' tagline.
Local reconstruction: Behind the logo are tan-grey bricks, the dark roof gutter and a dark blue metal clothesline rail. Continue the existing brick courses and mortar lines precisely. Keep the diagonal clothesline rail straight, in its exact position and thickness, with the same highlight and shadow. Do not bend, shift, replace or redesign any structural edge.
Constraints: Repair ONLY the pixels occupied by the DFH overlay and their immediate edges. Preserve all other visible photographic information exactly: viewpoint, composition, object positions, structure, materials, colour, exposure, texture, sharpness and grain. Do not beautify, denoise, sharpen, repaint or smooth the rest of the image.
Output: Return the complete supplied crop at 1536 x 1024 pixels if possible, with identical framing and no cropping or scaling. No added text or objects. This will be used as a small local patch on the original 4K photo.
